title: Add a GH Actions job to generate release notes
body:
Using the existing dev-bump workflow - which runs after a tag is pushed - add a new job to create a release notes PR. Use a generator script that generates the notes from GH Releases. This ensures that the notes are still updated even if someone forgets.

The script is largely LLM generated and I don't have the highest confidence in the code quality, but it is proven to work locally and the current version of RELEASE_NOTES.md on main was generated by it, so it seems to work fine.

Includes a fresh RELEASE_NOTES.md generated from a run of the script locally. There are a significant number of diffs resulting from the normalization of github.com/containers URLs to the new podman-container-tools project.

Point of concern: race condition setting up the release. If this runs before we have edited the release notes into the release, it will not generate a diff, so no PR gets made, so release notes remain un-updated. I don't think it will be a problem - this seems like the last thing to run during our release CI - but I am not 100% certain of this and it seems difficult to check without having a release happen.

RC releases should be ignored by the script, no diff is generated, no PR.

comments.body: The problem with that is 5.8.x. If we have a new 5.8.x, and we copy that into main, we either lose everything newer than it, or we are now obligated to make sure that every branch we are actively maintaining has the appropriate release notes (and do our release jobs properly identify release notes if they're in the middle of the file, not the top?).
